review: LISTEN HERE. Eleven hours a day in that cab and the radio runs out of things to say around hour four. "Saddle the Storm" came on somewhere west of Sidney, Nebraska at two in the morning and I sat up straight. This is trucker music that is also church and I did not know that existed. I posted it Monday to four hundred Christian drivers and my phone did not stop. Now here is the thing and I am saying it with love — there is NO WAY to download this. Coverage dies across half of Wyoming and all of the good parts of Montana and your site just stops. Four hundred drivers cannot use a thing that needs bars. Fix that and you will own the whole road. Keep it turning, keep it true, keep it kind.
